AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  JANUARY 21, 2020

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  January 21, 2020
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Criley, Roos, Lazzaro
Absent:  Walker
Also present: Acting City Manager, Community Development & Public Works Director, & City Engineer
  Ken Rukavina
  Planning Manager Brianna Rindge
  Planner Maddie Bright
  Assistant City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speaker: Janine Nendick

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  M-1357-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1162); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for structures exceeding 3.5’ within the front yard setback at the single-family residence located
  at 1816 Paseo Del Mar. Lot 24, Block 1190, Tract 7331. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Pacific Design, 25332 Narbonne Ave #100, Lomita, CA 90717

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Walker absent)
  with standard conditions.

NEW BUSINESS

2.  M-1360-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1161); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for nonstandard encroachments at the single-family residence located at 744 Cloyden Road. Lot
  16, Block 1276, Tract 7140. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Dale Sanchez

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to partially approve the application (4-0 in favor; Walker
  absent) with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) The property owner shall request
Action Minutes  Page 1 of 2

   a license agreement in order to maintain the existing nonstandard pedestrian walkway within City
  right-of-way along Cloyden Road; and 2) The proposed nonstandard driveway shall be shall be
  constructed per City Standards.

3.  NC-1666-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1163); Consideration of a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Application for requests for relief from standard conditions and additions to the
  single-family residence located at 1801 Via Estudillo. Lot 1, Block 1391, Tract 6889. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15303.

  Applicant: Michelle Anaya, 1412 Pine Ave, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner: David & Elizabeth Batty

  Speaker: Dwight Abbott

  Action: Wade moved and Roos seconded to approve the application (3-0 in favor; Criley abstained;
  Walker absent) with standard conditions and the following condition: 1) The pedestrian walkway
  shall be constructed per City Standards. Effectively, the request for relief from the standard
  condition requiring the property owner to plant street trees was denied.

4.  NC-653R-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1164); Consideration of a Revised Neighborhood
  Compatibility Application to remove a previously adopted condition of approval for the single-
  family residence located at 1624 Via Lazo. Lot 17, Block 1534, Tract 6884. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Allan Rigg, 6903 Cherty Dr, Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
  Owner: Masih Hakimpour

  Speakers: Ed Nowacki, John Zhang, Nas Bakopoulos, Janine Nendick

  Action: Roos moved and Criley seconded to deny the application (4-0 in favor; Walker absent).

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

5.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

6.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

7.  Meeting of December 17, 2019.

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to receive and file (4-0 in favor; Walker absent).

Adjourned at 8:29 p.m.

Adjourn to the Planning Commission meeting on Tuesday, February 18, 2020 at 6:30 p.m.

This Planning Commission meeting may be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City
website at www.pvestates.org.
